name: Damascus Chef Knife
shortDesc: Hand-forged VG10 Damascus chef knife with custom laser engraving available.
description: An 8-inch chef knife forged from 67 layers of Japanese VG10 Damascus steel. Razor-sharp, balanced, and built to last. Add your initials or a custom message with our precision laser engraving for a truly personal blade.

name: Tactical Folding Knife
shortDesc: D2 steel folding knife with ball-bearing pivot and optional handle engraving.
description: A 3.5-inch D2 tool steel blade with a stonewashed finish and ball-bearing pivot for smooth deployment. The textured G10 handle can be laser engraved with your name or logo.

name: Japanese Santoku Knife
shortDesc: 7-inch Santoku with granton edge — engrave the bolster with a monogram.
description: The all-purpose Japanese Santoku with a granton edge to prevent sticking. High-carbon stainless steel holds an edge beautifully. Personalize the bolster with laser engraving.

name: Steak Knife Set (4pc)
shortDesc: Full-tang serrated steak knives — perfect for engraved dinner sets.
description: Four full-tang steak knives with micro-serrated edges and polished handles. A beautiful addition to any dining table. Note: engraving not available on this set.

name: Minimalist Leather Wallet
shortDesc: Ultra-slim veg-tan leather wallet with interior laser engraving.
description: Crafted from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather that develops a rich patina over time. 6 card slots plus bill compartment. Add a hidden message or initials with interior laser engraving.

name: RFID Blocking Bifold
shortDesc: Classic bifold with RFID protection and custom exterior engraving.
description: A timeless bifold upgraded with RFID-blocking lining and a clear ID window. Personalize the exterior with laser-engraved initials, names, or a short quote.

name: Carbon Fiber Money Clip
shortDesc: Lightweight carbon fiber clip with precision laser engraving.
description: Ultra-lightweight carbon fiber money clip that securely holds bills and up to 6 cards. Engrave your initials or a short message on the clip face.

name: Custom Laser Engraving
shortDesc: Add a personalized laser engraving to any engravable product.
description: Make it yours with our precision laser engraving. Add names, initials, dates, coordinates, or short messages to knives, wallets, and more. Preview your design live before checkout.
